entries.title: Avatars LTX Current State
entries.summary: Avatars LTX is an Electron desktop application combining a React renderer with a Python FastAPI generation backend.
entries.body: The desktop application supports AI video generation and related production workflows. Revalidate feature-specific behavior against the configured integration branch because active feature work may exist in separate worktrees.

entries.title: Avatars LTX System Architecture
entries.summary: The product has React renderer, Electron main/preload, and Python FastAPI backend layers.
entries.body: Frontend code lives under `frontend/`, Electron lifecycle and IPC under `electron/`, and generation orchestration under `backend/`. Preserve the IPC and authenticated backend-fetch boundaries when changing cross-layer behavior.

entries.title: Backend Architecture Contract
entries.summary: Routes remain thin, handlers own logic, services isolate side effects, and state transitions are lock-aware and typed.
entries.body: Use `_routes` for transport plumbing, `AppHandler` as the composition root, handlers for logic, service protocols and fakes for heavy side effects, and centralized typed state. Do not hold the shared lock during expensive I/O or compute. Integration tests use service fakes rather than mocks.

entries.title: Frontend and IPC Contract
entries.summary: Renderer state uses React contexts, backend requests use backendFetch, and Electron access goes through the preload bridge.
entries.body: Do not call the application backend with raw `fetch`; use `backendFetch`. Keep Electron communication behind `window.electronAPI`. Preserve the view-based ProjectContext navigation and existing semantic Tailwind tokens.

entries.title: Avatars LTX Validation Contract
entries.summary: Changes require strict TypeScript/Python checks, backend tests, and a frontend build before review.
entries.body: Run `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm backend:test`, and `pnpm build:frontend`. When backend contracts change, regenerate the OpenAPI client before validation and include generated diffs in review.

entries.title: Avatars LTX Known Limitations
entries.summary: The frontend currently has no dedicated automated test suite; validation relies on types, backend integration tests, builds, and targeted UI evidence.
entries.body: Frontend changes must compensate for the absence of a dedicated frontend test suite with strict type checking, production builds, focused runtime checks, and before/after evidence when applicable.
